summary: Expose advanced miner anchor gap configuration and verified historical work status
details: Keep setup unchanged and default local gap to 2. Add mining configure --anchor-gap, preserve explicit zero during setup edits and upgrades, and pass the value to the managed chain runtime.

Distinguish saved gap, running geth arguments, latest candidate and the Go miner's submitted historical work. Report selection height, actual gap, reason, anchor age and pass; unavailable diagnostics are not guessed.
Apply policy changes through existing chain-only reconciliation without rebuilding datasets or reauthorizing mining; committed-state recovery barriers remain enforced.
operator_actions: Use usdb-node mining configure --anchor-gap N only for advanced local policy changes, then usdb-node up and mining status. Ordinary setup keeps the recommended gap.
Upgrade the node kit and chain image together. Independent multi-node gap measurements remain a separate qualification stage.
